transfer_assessment.assessment: Selected concepts can be rehearsed against Git observations, but the full candidate-model inventory is not completely assessed and authoritative definitions remain unavailable.

forced_fit_assessment.assessment: Git merge conflicts are preserved only as an instrument-test input for forced-fit assessment pressure, not as a Structology concept mapping. They may stress the Transfer and State mappings, but they do not establish a Forced Fit outcome in a non-authoritatively-bound rehearsal.

partial_fit_assessment.assessment: Partial preservation can be rehearsed for assessed concepts, but the concept inventory records several insufficient-evidence and excluded dispositions. Partial Transfer is therefore not reached as a transfer outcome.

failure_assessment.assessment: The rehearsal could not bind immutable content references for the three external methodology artifacts from the active workspace. This blocks canonical pilot execution conformance and prevents reaching a domain transfer outcome.

deviation_records.description: Immutable methodology and Structology references were available only as issue-supplied title/version labels, not as content-addressed local files, release URLs, tags, or hashes.
deviation_records.impact: Limits exact replay and prevents canonical Pilot Execution #1 status.
deviation_records.disposition: Recorded; methodology not revised; artifact reclassified as pre-reference instrument harness rehearsal.

failure_records.description: Full authoritative text of Structology Candidate Model v0.1, Methodology Engineering Contract v0.1, and Cross-Domain Structology Transfer Audit v0.1 was not present in the active workspace and was identified by review as not yet frozen.
failure_records.impact: Definitions could not be independently verified; execution validity is BLOCKED and transfer outcome is NOT_REACHED.
failure_records.disposition: Recorded; conclusion separates execution validity from transfer determination.
